title: The constant sheaf of sets with value E is represented by the disjoint union of E copies of the base
statement: Let $U$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E$ a set. Let $U_E=\coprod_{e\in E}U$ be the coproduct of copies of $U$ indexed by $E$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], with coprojections $\iota_e:U\to U_E$, and let $\pi:U_E\to U$ be the codiagonal, the morphism with $\pi\circ\iota_e=\mathrm{id}_U$ for all $e\in E$; regard $U_E$ as a $U$-scheme through $\pi$. Let $h_{U_E}$ be the presheaf of sets on the small etale site $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] given by $h_{U_E}(s:W\to U)=\operatorname{Mor}_U(W,U_E)$, restriction being composition, and let $\underline E$ be the constant sheaf of sets on $U_{\Et}$ with value $E$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], with its canonical map $\eta$ from the constant presheaf $W\mapsto E$. Then $h_{U_E}$ is a sheaf of sets on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], and the morphism of presheaves $c$ from the constant presheaf $W\mapsto E$ to $h_{U_E}$, $c_{(W,s)}(e)=\iota_e\circ s$, factors as $c=\varphi\circ\eta$ for a unique morphism of sheaves $\varphi:\underline E\to h_{U_E}$, and $\varphi$ is an isomorphism. (For $E=\varnothing$, $U_\varnothing$ is the empty scheme.)
